workout.session_type: DAY A - Lower (squat emphasis) - 80 MIN TARGET

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 - Barbell Back Squat (SAFETY PINS MANDATORY) - ALONE, NOT PAIRED
exercises.detail: 205 lb - 3 x 8. Last time you went 8/7/6 with at least 1 in reserve on set 3. Same weight, chase 8/8/7. Pins set every single set.

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 - Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.detail: 200 lb - 3 x 12 (UP from 180 - you got 12 clean on all three sets). If 12 goes easy again, next lower day is 220.

exercises.name: BLOCK 2 PAIR - Leg Press + Seated Leg Curl
exercises.detail: Leg Press 340 lb x 10 (Saturday you finished at 370, so 340 is a real working weight not a retest), then straight into Seated Leg Curl 88 lb x 10. 3 rounds.

exercises.name: BLOCK 3 - Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Pallof Press 25 lb x 12/side, Dead Bugs x 24, Side Plank 45 sec/side. NO hanging work today - your grip has been the limiter two sessions running, give it a break.

exercises.name: FINISHER - Incline Walk
exercises.detail: Set the minutes in the app to whatever you actually do. GOVERN BY BREATHING, NOT HR - in this heat your HR reads 10-20 bpm high at the same real workload, so do not chase a number. Pace you could speak a sentence at. HARD STOP on lightheadedness. This is a lower day, which is when Saturday's episode happened, so cool actively: water over head and neck, wet towel, fan. Log your HR range this time.
